retailers.name: Blue Nile
retailers.return_exclusions_detail: Personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after initial purchase, Diamond Upgrade Program purchases, clearance items and 'Final Sale' items are not eligible for return or exchange.
retailers.resize_policy: Eligible rings receive one free resize, up or down two sizes, within 6 months of purchase if the design permits.
retailers.payment_methods_verified: Product pages name 'the Blue Nile Credit Card' as a payment/financing option (verbatim on item 203348, retrieved 2026-10-22). General card networks (Visa/Mastercard/Amex) are not named on the retrieved pages.
retailers.payment_note: Corrected 2026-10-22 (independent review finding R6-04): the earlier blanket note that card acceptance was 'not stated on the retrieved pages' was wrong — Blue Nile's own store credit card is stated on product pages. A store card is not the same as a general-purpose credit card; no chargeback/protection outcome is inferred.

items resized after initial purchase

retailers.name: Zales
retailers.return_window_basis: Standalone policy: 'You may return your purchase within 30 days of the purchase(shipped) date.' Jewelry exchanges within 60 days. Product pages also state 'Free and easy 30-day returns'.
retailers.return_exclusions_detail: Policy: 'Returns and exchanges are not allowed on special ordered watches, custom designs, ear piercing earrings, gift cards and merchandise received via the Jewelry Replacement Plan.' Jewelry must be in good condition. Resized / sized-to-order rings are not addressed in the retrieved policy text, so resized treatment stays blank.
retailers.price_display_basis: Ring price includes the diamonds shown (complete ring, not setting-only)
retailers.payment_methods_verified: Policy names 'Credit and Debit Cards' as an original-purchase tender (refunds credited to the same account). Card networks are not stated on the retrieved page.
retailers.payment_note: Verified from the standalone return policy retrieved 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819). Refund-to-tender language confirms cards are accepted tender; it does not name Visa/Mastercard/Amex networks.

retailers.name: VRAI
retailers.return_window_basis: Full policy (last revised March 21, 2025, retrieved 2026-10-22): eligible items returned within 30 days; under $15,000 = full store credit or refund minus recycling fee ($300 for an engagement ring); $15,000+ = store credit only. Product page summarizes: 'Returns accepted within 30 days; unworn items with original packaging'.
retailers.return_exclusions_detail: Policy NON-ELIGIBLE list includes verbatim: 'Modified or resized rings', 'Custom-designed items', 'Items altered by a third-party', personalized fine jewelry, gift cards, and shipping/engraving fees. Refund to original payment carries a $300 recycling fee for engagement rings (waived for full store credit). Free return shipping in the U.S. EU withdrawal carve-outs also exclude rings made to accommodate a customer-configured diamond.
retailers.resize_policy: One complimentary resize up to one full U.S. size (policy page, retrieved 2026-10-22).
retailers.price_display_basis: Setting price (center stone selected separately in the configurator)

retailers.name: Stone and Strand
retailers.return_window_basis: Policy: 'From the date your order arrives at your door, we offer 100 days to receive a return' (U.S. customers only). Item must be unworn with the original security tag attached.
retailers.return_exclusions_detail: Policy excludes: final-sale items (anything marked final sale on the product page OR purchased at a discount of 50% or greater); personalized jewelry (custom, engraved, monogrammed); made-to-order jewelry (final sale); worn items (store credit only at their discretion, 20%+ restocking fee); international returns not accepted. A $12.50 return fee applies to refunds. Resizing is not mentioned in the retrieved policy text.
retailers.price_display_basis: Complete ring (diamonds included in the listed price)
retailers.payment_methods_verified: Returns page refers to refunds 'to the original payment method' and to 'your credit card provider'. Card networks are not stated on the retrieved page.
retailers.payment_note: Basis: Stone and Strand returns page retrieved 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819). Refund language implies card tender; networks not named. Same evidentiary standard as Zales.
